evidence: AC1 (named constants, single charge): NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N = 2.0/14.007 and DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N = 1.0/14.007 are defined in process.rs with Stumm & Morgan citation. Alkalinity is charged only at AOB and comammox TAN-oxidation steps; NOB explicitly does not consume alkalinity (confirmed by code comment at nitrogen_cycle.rs:374-375 and dedicated test).

AC2 (cycling pH decline): `cycling_without_water_changes_shows_ph_decline` test passes — isolates alkalinity→pH pathway by zeroing growth yields and filter flow, running 96 simulated hours, and asserting pH decreased.

AC3 (soft-water vs hard-water buffering): `soft_water_declines_faster_than_hard_water` test passes — runs KH 2 and KH 8 tanks under identical ammonia load for 48 hours, asserts soft-water pH drop > hard-water pH drop.

AC4 (closed-system mass balance): `closed_system_alkalinity_mass_balance` test passes — verifies initial_alk - final_alk ≈ total_N_nitrified × NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N within 10% tolerance (accounting for biomass growth routing). Also validates ratio of consumed alk to TAN is between 80%-105% of stoichiometric constant.

AC5 (budget/tracing visibility): Engine emits 5 budget metrics (water.alkalinity_meq.delta, tan_oxidized_mg, nitrate_produced_mg_n, alkalinity_consumed_meq, alkalinity_produced_meq) and 10 trace notes including per-guild breakdown. `tracing_shows_alkalinity_attribution` test validates both budget entries and trace notes contain alkalinity attribution. StageTrace::metric() is now guarded by budget_metrics_enabled flag (accepted amendment applied), with 2 dedicated unit tests verifying independent note/metric gating.

AC6 (denitrification return path): alkalinity_produced_meq field on NitrogenCycleOutput is wired as zero placeholder. DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N constant is defined, exported, and tested. net_alkalinity_delta_meq() helper computes produced - consumed. process.rs documentation provides explicit wiring instructions for E4b. Engine already emits produced metric, so denitrification only needs to populate the field.
Quality gates: cargo clippy -D warnings — clean. cargo fmt --check — clean. All 6 nitrification tests pass. All 20 tracing tests pass. All 24 budget tracking tests pass. 2 StageTrace unit tests pass.

Accepted amendments applied: (1) comammox now decrements alk_budget (nitrogen_cycle.rs:351) with debug_assert on invariant; (2) StageTrace::metric() guarded by budget_metrics_enabled flag (engine.rs:100).

Pre-existing failure: save_load_with_active_cycle_state (save_load.rs:368) is a floating-point determinism issue in save/load round-trips, present before this work and acknowledged in both prior stage outputs — not introduced or worsened by this change set.
findings_or_gaps: alkalinity_produced_meq remains a zero-valued placeholder until denitrification lands (E4b). This is expected and documented — the interface is ready but production is not yet implemented.
The save_load_with_active_cycle_state test failure is pre-existing and out of scope for this bead, but should be tracked separately to prevent it from masking future regressions in the broader suite.
